summary: Search-Ready Pages (head-only prerender) verified. `CI=false yarn build` succeeds and prints 'Prerendered 24 pages' (5 static + 8 tools + 6 legal + 5 blog). A validator script parses every generated html and checks for exactly 1 title, 1 meta description and 1 canonical, that each matches the source Seo props (data files and the hardcoded strings in Home/AllTools/Blog/FaqPage/Contact) and is unique per page, and that JSON-LD on home/tools/blog is valid JSON: 24/24 pass. A static server with clean URLs (npx serve build -l 5066) served the route-specific head without JS for /merge-pdf, /blog, /blog/<slug>, /faq and /privacy-policy. Blog subfolder pages use absolute /static asset paths, so they hydrate correctly. A Playwright run against the static build hydrated without page errors. Client-side nav merge→blog→article→faq→privacy→compress→home always kept exactly 1 canonical, 1 description, 1 robots and at most 1 #page-jsonld, and each was updated correctly. The preview dev server is unaffected (pages and /api are 200, and nav updates the head).
action_items: Optional (low): prerendered JSON-LD differs from the client JSON-LD. Home has no potentialAction SearchAction. /faq has no FAQPage JSON-LD. Tool pages have no FAQ JSON-LD (in the client it is rendered in the body by ToolPage). Google renders JS, so this is a small gap.

Optional (low): prerender.js hardcodes title/description for Home/AllTools/Blog/FAQ/Contact, so they can drift from the page components. They match today. Consider moving them into a shared data file.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicated SEO strings between scripts/prerender.js and the page components (risk of drift; the validator script will catch it)
Seo.jsx comment mentions 'Vite build uses react-helmet-async'. This is stale because the app uses CRA/craco with a custom prerender
updated_files: /app/frontend/scripts/test_prerender_heads.js (new validator; run: cd /app/frontend && node -r sucrase/register/js scripts/test_prerender_heads.js after build)
context_for_next_testing_agent: A stale `serve -s build -l 5055` process (another cwd) returns 404 for everything. Use another port with an absolute path: npx serve /app/frontend/build -l 5066. Unknown routes return 404 under plain serve (no SPA fallback). Firebase handles this with the ** rewrite, which is an accepted limitation.
